d: The UT683KIT is an intelligent wire tracker which consists of the transmitter and receiver, this kit is designed with strong anti-interference ability. The receiver can quickly and accurately locate the target cable. This kit can automatically identify open, short, polarity, and quickly distinguish cable failure.

Product size Transmitter-130mm x 51mm x 28mm; Receiver-197mm x 48mm x 34mm
Standard accessories USB cable, RJ11 aligator clip test cable, RJ45 test cable, RJ11 test cable, English manual
Standard individual packing Gift box, carrying bag
